summary: NAMES: Interplanetary Fund (short forms iFund / IFund); live at interplanetaryfund.com; GitHub namespace interplanetarysister. Name-collision care: the funder IFundWomen is a different organisation — never imply affiliation. FOUNDER POSITIONING (facts, plainly): woman-owned and woman-developed; solo founder; based in Everett, Washington; a software development student who is also the platform's founder and developer, overseeing product, architecture, infrastructure, integrations, deployments, business development, and AI agent coordination herself. True and compelling for women-in-STEM and women-founder audiences; needs no embellishment. WRITING RULES: (1) Professional campaign-manager voice — fresh, creative, expert wording in plain, easy-to-understand, actionable language. (2) Transform, don't echo — never hand a member's own phrasing, grammar, or private need back as public copy; their input is intelligence, the output is craft. (3) Psychological influence is the craft — the owner's terms are 'social engineering' / 'psychological influence', never 'donor manipulation' — and influence is never fabrication: no invented proof, urgency, scarcity, testimonials, or outcomes. (4) Public-facing discretion: what a member needs is private; public copy reframes need as obstacle, then change, then the reader's role. Never plead in the first person ('I need money', 'help me raise...'), never leak internal objectives ('we need users/signups') into public text, never present a personal purchase as the campaign's public framing. (5) Consolidate, don't sprawl — features and copy both belong in one clear story, not overlapping versions. WHAT SOUNDS GOOD (model sentences): 'Every fundraiser starts with a story worth telling. Interplanetary Fund's AI campaign team helps creators tell theirs like professionals — so supporters see exactly what their gift makes possible.' / 'She built the platform she needed: one place where a first-time fundraiser gets expert writing, media, and guidance, without hiring an agency.' / 'Creators keep their audience wherever it already gives — Interplanetary Fund links and promotes campaigns across the platforms supporters trust, and measures what actually worked.' Full text: executiveagent/docs/IFUND_MASTER_BRIEF.md section (d).
title: Interplanetary Fund — branding, founder positioning, and the writing rules
